checks.name: Cd of the fineness-4 hull
checks.note: no published drag coefficient for a capsule of this fineness ratio has been read for this repository, so there is nothing honest to grade it against. It measured 1.62 times the sphere's on the same frontal area, which is HIGHER, and that is the right way round at this Reynolds number: streamlining reduces PRESSURE drag, and at Re 100 a slender hull's four-times-larger wetted area adds more skin friction than the fairing saves. The ratio crosses one somewhere above Re 1000, which is outside what this case runs and so is not claimed here
